$comment: Advisories scripts/audit-check.mjs should not block on.
Every entry needs a reason and an expiry: a waiver is a decision to revisit,
not a decision to forget. Past the expiry the gate fails again on purpose.
id      GHSA identifier, exactly as it appears in the advisory URL.
reason  Why this one cannot reach us, or what we are waiting on upstream.
expires YYYY-MM-DD. Keep it short - a quarter is usually plenty.
